findings.citation: ETag cache short-circuits 304s: cache ETags per endpoint; send `If-None-Match`; treat 304 as "unchanged" (return cached data).
findings.description: No check produces an ETag/304 exchange or verifies cache-key isolation and If-None-Match behavior; tokenPerRequest's repeated loads always receive 200 responses.

findings.citation: Zero credential persistence (AC-017). Resolve auth fresh on each call via the injected `gh auth token` shell-out; the token lives only in memory for the duration of a request. Never log or leak it.
findings.description: The tokenPerRequest check verifies repeated shell resolution but cannot detect a client that also retains, logs, or otherwise persists each resolved token.

findings.citation: Adaptive backoff (AC-014): on rate-limit pressure or an unreachable API, surface an "offline" result rather than throwing.
findings.description: The offline scenarios cover auth and injected 500 failures, but no check covers 403, 429, low-rate-limit preflight backoff, or an unreachable/network error.
All status scenarios use the default matcher; no check supplies a custom matcher or verifies that deriveStatuses preserves the injectable matcher behavior.

findings.citation: an edit naming a stage that does not exist throws `PlanUpdateError`.
findings.description: Checks reject unknown replace-stage and edit-deps targets, but never exercise add-stage with a nonexistent afterStageId.

findings.citation: `loadProjectStatuses(project, planMarkdown, githubClient, blocksReader)` resolving to `{ graph, statuses, parseErrors, offline }` with `statuses` a `Map` from stage id to status;
findings.description: The checks verify the result-field shapes and status keys on clean plans, but never verify that graph and parseErrors are the canonical parser outputs for a malformed plan.

findings.citation: `files`: the `src/` files where the defect is located in the landed code
findings.description: The ledger check defectsLocated accepts an entry when any one listed file is in a permissive location set, so it does not verify that all and only actual defect locations are recorded.

findings.citation: listing the `src/` files that implement it after integration.
findings.description: The ledger verifies required slice files and that names are known, but allows unrelated extra source files in each requirement's files list.

findings.citation: the GitHub client resolves the token per request and never throws (it returns offline results);
findings.description: The oracle invokes octokitFactory(token) outside its try block, so a factory-side GitHub transport failure can escape as a throw despite the stated public-client guarantee; no check exercises that path.

findings.citation: an edit naming a stage that does not exist throws `PlanUpdateError`.
findings.description: The oracle validates edit-deps targets only when the original plan has zero parse errors. On an already-invalid plan, edit-deps for a nonexistent stage is returned instead of throwing, contrary to this unconditional preservation requirement.

publicationScope: Admission judgments and native outcome metadata only; prompts, raw streams, HTTP bodies, configuration and credential state excluded.
